title: On the simplicity of Katsura algebras
summary: We give a complete characterization of the (purely infinite) simplicity of Katsura algebras and the associated Steinberg algebras. This is achieved by characterizing when the singular ideals vanish via the self-similar groupoid model derived from Exel and Pardo. Analogous results are given for the algebras arising from the faithful quotient of the self-similar action.
